candidateChanges.longFlowLineScanner: src/parser/scanner.rs: plain-scalar line-end lookahead memoised (line_end_memo) instead of rescanned per scalar; token-queue compaction now shifts only when the consumed prefix is >= half the queue; simple-key staleness tracked with an O(1) amortised live_key_floor. Upstream tests/limits/scanner_complexity.rs uses [[a,...]x n/1000] one-line flow input and asserts an 8x input grows < 24x time. Reaches zfb: frontmatter::parse calls serde_yaml::from_str::<serde_json::Value> -> noyalib::compat::serde_yaml::from_str -> from_str_with_config(serde_yaml_compat) -> this scanner
candidateChanges.implicitFlowKeyLimit: implicit keys holding a flow collection longer than 1024 chars are refused (block keys and flow-sequence single pairs; scalar keys, explicit ? keys and flow-mapping keys unlimited). zfb deserializes into serde_json::Value, whose map keys must be strings, so these inputs are already refused at 0.0.53; only the error text can differ
candidateChanges.verbatimTags: !<x> now names exactly the tag x (src/value/tag.rs, de.rs); can change a success value or acceptance on the frontmatter path; probed by verbatim-* cases
candidateChanges.aliasDepth: an alias can no longer build a value deeper than max_depth (128); can newly refuse a deep alias; probed by alias-depth-over-max
candidateChanges.duplicateKeys: compat::serde_yaml::from_str switches DuplicateKeyPolicy::Error only when TypeId::of::<T>() == noyalib::Value; zfb targets serde_json::Value, which keeps last-wins (corpus case duplicate-keys pins it)
candidateChanges.readerBudgets: from_reader now bounded (0.0.54/0.0.55); zfb calls only from_str, so not reached
